reviewer_notes: Searches for dependent, spouse, husband/wife, family, domestic partner, subscriber, single/two-person/family tier, and survivor coverage (both regex over the form-feed text and document-scoped FTS on "dependent coverage insurance", "spouse family coverage", "domestic partner", "family plan single two person premium") turn up no clause extending health coverage to dependents: Article Six (PDF pp12-13) sets one premium share with no coverage tiers, spouse appears only in the assignment article (PDF p18) and the bereavement definition of immediate family (PDF p31), and the plan-description appendices are physically absent from this PDF (printed footer jumps 44 -> 53 between PDF pp45-46). A's quote is real and its page 11 is the correct PDF page (printed footer 10), but Article Five.I's Dependent Care Reimbursement Plan is a dependent-care/premium-conversion/FSA package "for the benefit of the members of the bargaining unit," not dependent health coverage, so it supports a different provision; the quote also carries a "Section I states" label and a trailing ellipsis. B's not_discussed is the defensible reading.
